subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram album support be added through the existing `send`/`mediaUrls` delivery contract, through a new Telegram-specific message action such as `send-media-group`, or deferred in favor of sequential sends?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the fix changes the message tool and Telegram delivery semantics; automation should not choose the durable product/API surface while an open draft implementation already proposes one shape.

options.title: Port album batching into existing send/mediaUrls
options.body: Keep the current message action surface and batch eligible Telegram media lists inside the Telegram plugin, falling back to sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Sponsor the new action shape
options.body: Adopt or port the open fork PR's explicit `send-media-group` action if maintainers want album sending to be opt-in and Telegram-specific.

options.title: Defer album grouping
options.body: Leave current sequential media delivery as the supported behavior and close or supersede the open draft PR with a clear product rationale.

recommendation.title: Port album batching into existing send/mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Keep the current message action surface and batch eligible Telegram media lists inside the Telegram plugin, falling back to sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already left the maintainer cleanup comment on this issue and is the strongest available routing signal for the product-direction decision.
